name: Clover Memory's
source:
A project to celebrate 20th anniversary of ALcot also marked as ALcot's last project.
Crowdfunding starts on [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/709853]Campfire Crowdfunding website[/url] at April 13th 2024.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ALcot_official/status/1753010312834408915]Game Teaser Movie on ALcot's Official Twitter[/url]]

No matter what, I could not forget.
The "memory" that should have been important was worn out.
It turned into a "scar" that I did not want to remember.

In a Western-style manor overlooking the harbor, there live two twin brothers. Although their relationship has become strained due to a past event, by welcoming the two foreign students from the United States, the twin sisters "Yuna" and "Hina," a warm light finally lit the deserted dining table.

Despite their differences, all four of them are attracted to each other. Beginning of a new story, the cherished memories with [i]kouhai[/i] and childhood friends. Quarreling, forgiving, feeling something for each other everyday.

The time for graduation draws near. Leaves of memories gather into one, forming an irreplaceable​ "bond."

"I won't say goodbye."

There, reaching out, because you are there, my beloved――

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.alcot.biz/product/clm/story.html]official website[/url]]
